description: This PHP class 'CandidateAttachmentDecorator' provides methods to interact with CandidateAttachment entities, including retrieving file content and associating a candidate by ID. It acts as a decorator enhancing CandidateAttachment functionality within the HRM system.

classes.name: CandidateAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for CandidateAttachment providing additional methods to handle file content and associate candidates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a CandidateAttachment entity.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the file content from the attachment, handling resource conversion if necessary.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with the attachment by candidate ID.
